pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with low edge angularity. Edge gradients are smooth and exhibit signs of motion blur, reducing pixel-level sharpness. Patches are dark relative to the corridor network and occupy the majority of the visible surface area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways with relatively uniform pixel width across the flank. The topological graph is composed primarily of tri-radial junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical and dorsal regions. The 1D geometric contour is visible but softened by motion blur against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Three avian organisms are perched along the dorsal ridge at the upper-neck, mid-neck, and shoulder-line positions, creating localized occlusions of the mane silhouette.
